build_system: Expo CLI with Metro bundler, npm for package management
test_command: No tests configured - verify via expo export
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npx expo export --platform web to verify the bundle compiles without errors.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full npm access available. Node.js v22 available via nvm. No physical device or emulator available for testing - rely on web export for build verification.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. Standard Expo conventions apply.
key_patterns: Single App.js entry point using registerRootComponent. Components in src/components/ as .jsx files. Constants in src/constants/. Uses react-native-safe-area-context and react-native-svg. Dark theme with teal/cyan accent colors. Animated API for animations.
directory_structure: Root: App.js (main), index.js (entry), app.json (expo config), package.json. src/components/ has 3 components (BreathingVisual, PhaseDisplay, Controls). src/constants/ has patterns.js with breathing pattern data. assets/ has icons.
